summary: Adaptive soft-ranking over hard-eligible candidates only, fail-open integration into RoleRouter, explainable decisions and a durable routing feedback ledger
implementation: src/shared/adaptive-routing.ts: ExpectedUtility contract (P(completion) × quality × goalFidelity − restriction − blockingRisk − latencyCost − resourceCost) with pure expectedUtility/clamp01; AdaptiveCandidateScore; AdaptiveRoutingDecision (candidates/selected/usedFallbackRouter/exploration); AdaptiveRerankRequest/Candidate/Result; AdaptiveReranker seam; NEUTRAL_PRIOR for unlearned candidates; ADAPTIVE_POLICY_VERSION

electron/learning/routing/adaptive-scorer.ts: AdaptiveScorer — flag-gated (adaptiveRouting + umbrella); resolves role→global baselines from a profile resolver, applies concept-conditioned deviations, proxies quality from completion only when no verification samples exist, computes utility + confidence, emits per-candidate explanation lines; rerank() never throws (any failure ⇒ undefined ⇒ caller keeps deterministic order); pin forced to the top

electron/learning/routing/routing-feedback.ts: RoutingFeedbackLedger — durable decision records with explanations, attachEpisode(decisionId, episodeId), latestForTask, explain() answering 'why B not A'; corrupt file degrades without throwing

electron/commander/role-router.ts (+): optional AdaptiveReranker + adaptive context (taskId/model snapshot/epoch/fingerprint); applied strictly AFTER hard filtering; defensive verification that the reranker only reorders the exact candidate set; pin priority enforced; exception/missing reranker ⇒ unchanged deterministic order; adaptiveOutcome() exposes the last decision
tests: tests/unit/engine-phase-6.test.ts (13 tests): utility monotonicity/penalties; A31 historically-low completion with high confidence down-weighted (web:b reordered ahead of web:a); unlearned candidates keep static order via neutral prior; A37 adaptive off ⇒ inert; A01 no-reranker router unchanged; A23 reorder-only-approved candidates; A24/A25 excluded/capability-less never restored; A26 pin keeps priority; A27 throwing reranker and candidate-injecting reranker both fall back; A28 broken profile resolver still routes deterministically; A35 explain() names the selected runtime with completion/utility factors; feedback ledger links decision→episode

gates.full_suite: 59 files / 370 tests PASS (RoleRouter change verified against all existing suites)

notes: Addresses A01, A23-A28, A31, A35, A37. Exploration is intentionally disabled here (Phase 9 owns it).
